decisions.rationale: The topic-level SME criticism correctly identified that the first foreign-key definition incorrectly applied the matching rule to null values. The corrected HTML teaches that every non-null foreign-key value must match and that NOT NULL makes the relationship mandatory, with the same rule retained in recap and static companion text. The independent topic SME recheck resolves the finding on the current artifact bytes, and the final independent SME recheck confirms those bytes remain unchanged at 639b46d81ae3d461559a06af13ce1a7d4eb4cf84.
